notes.title: 0.7 update - One major update left for FINAL release!
notes.content:
[h1]We have reached version 0.7![/h1]

[h2]What's new:[/h2]

[list]
[*] - Access to a new area located near Amerithia, passing through the Order's headquarters and up stairs, has been unlocked. This area is called “Birstall” and features a boss monster. It is important to complete this area in order to continue with the rest of the update.
[*] - Access to the pyramid located in the Aridiah desert has been unlocked, where an Adeptis boss awaits you at the top. This area will have a couple of unplayable zones until the next major update.
[*] - Added a small portion of the map in the central part of the Stralsund ruins, where you will get a key, necessary to continue.
[*] - Unlocked the rest of the volcanic area where an Adeptis boss and a key awaits you.
[*] - Update 0.7 concludes in the snow mountain area, Eztilia, where you will find another key, you must have four green keys to reach the last boss located near the train station in Eztilia. After the boss the 0.7 update concludes with a cinematic.
[*] - An extra room was added in Neummann's lab, which contains a key that will be needed to open a door in the upper right part of Grijayla, passing through Eztilia, which will unlock more parts of the map and dialogues.
[*] - [b]Doom now runs in Toziuha Night.[/b] (Hidden achievement).
[/list]

- This update does not contain Portuguese translation, it will be added in a minor patch this week.

[b]In short, you must first go to the new area near Amerithia, and then get 4 keys for the train station in Eztilia.
[/b]

For bug reports or feedback, you can contact the developer on Steam forums and Discord.

[b]This is the penultimate update before the final version. Version 0.8 is expected to arrive in mid-August. [/b]

[h1]Map reference[/h1]

notes.title: Mod Support implemented! v0.6.1
notes.content:
During the 0.6 update I haven't received much feedback (I don't know if it's good or bad news) but from the few people who have given opinions of these new zones I have implemented some small improvements. It will be the only patch while I work on 0.7 thanks for the support!

- Some enemies can drop items that heal the negative state they cause.
- The “poison” has been slightly lowered the damage.
- The “ injury” time has been lowered from 20 seconds to 10 seconds.
- There is a transmutable accessory in the lab that gives invulnerability from negative states.
- Some material drops of some enemies.
- Fixed a bug with the “congelatio” circuit.
- Added extra save statues in the new zones.

New things:
- A re-implementation of the Steam-SDK has been done to add Workshop support!
- The game now has mod support! Using the Steam Workshop system or by adding the mod files in the mods folder of the game (user/documents/toziuha... mods).

notes.title: 0.6 Update! Two new areas and new bosses!
notes.content:
[h1]New features[/h1]
- Two new zones available with new enemies and two Adeptis bosses ready to fight.
- Toziuha Night is now “[b]Steam Deck verified[/b]”!
- Data saving (game saves, game settings) is now cross-platform between windows and linux.
- Bestiary available, capitalized names of several enemies are placeholders.
- Alchemy Lab available.
- The secret room of Neumann's Laboratory can be opened as the necessary elements can be found on the map.
- Difficulty option available: See the life and weaknesses of enemies in real time.
- Rachel, Margaret and Restaurant side missions can be completed.
- New inventory items available through Transmutation.
- Food can be purchased in Restaurant, the food will make temporary buff of stats and other secondary effects.
- Added “Room Preload” option, it's an experimental option that allows to load in the background the next room when the player gets closer to the exit, allowing a faster transition between rooms, disabled by default.
- The map display screen has been improved.
- In easy mode the player will be able to use the Carpatitia effect on death whenever they want, no one is left behind.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42870047/a3b95ce937cd5ca34fd1b3ce2a2d18bdd50b7849.png[/img]

[h1]Bugfixes/Balances[/h1]
- Fixed bug of character sliding unintentionally when attacking.
- Boss “Joseph” statistics modified.
- “Kankra” enemy attack modified.
- “Stella ferrum” and “Pyro Projetium” circuits nerfed.
- Item prices in the store have been adjusted.
- Statistics of equipable items have been changed.
- Several bugfixes made for the two new areas.

[h2]Important! [/h2]
This update and the following ones will be more linear, because the initial release of the early access game already represented 60% of the full game and small parts of the map that are not yet finished are being locked/unlocked, so it's recommended to read this small guide for the 0.6.x version of the game, try to read each point every time you get stuck.

[h1]Guide for 0.6.x[/h1]
- A train station has been added in Eldralis forest.
- It will be possible to go through the upper left area of Eldralis forest where the elevator is and help an NPC.
- The NPC in Eldralis unlocks “sulfuric acid” in the store, needed for transmutations in the Alchemy lab.
- A new zone can be visited after defeating the boss “Atargatis”, where you can get an “elemental action circuit” that will be necessary to continue in the upper-right part of the map (Eztilia, the 2nd new zone).
- A small area in the lower part of Stralsund (where the NPC to be rescued was) is available, it contains some items that improve stats.
- In the snowy area you can rescue another NPC that unlocks a new item in the store, it will be important to pass to an unlocked area in the left-bottom area of Stralsund passing through the save-room.
- In the new area of Stralsund unlocked you can get a new skill, it will serve to continue in the snowy area, at the end awaits a new boss and another ability to go in the dark subterranean area of Grijayla where the second and last boss of this update will be.

[h1]+19,000 wishlists![/h1]
We are close to reaching 20k people adding Toziuha Night to the wishlist! Thank you all for your support.

notes.title: Demo is now Available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42870047/b65afd78d449e6ac884177f29fdc183952ae2e5a.png[/img]

[h3]Hello to all metroidvania game lovers! The demo update of my game Toziuha Night: Order of the Alchemists is finally here![/h3]

I'm [url=https://dannygaray60.github.io/]Danny Garay[/url], the [b]solo developer[/b] behind this project, and I'm thrilled to introduce you to the new and exciting features you'll find in the updated demo. But first of all, let me thank [b]Lydium Music[/b] for their amazing work on the game's soundtrack - their music has really taken the Toziuha Night experience to another level!

Now, let's talk about the improvements I've made to the demo. I've carefully read player feedback and worked hard to implement several requested improvements and additions. From gameplay tweaks to visual improvements.

I redesigned the map for the game's prologue. I commissioned other people for the art. In addition, I have introduced new powers and abilities for our badass non-heroine Xandria.

The updated demo of Toziuha Night: Order of the Alchemists is just a preview of what's to come in the full game! I'm excited to share this experience with all of you and to hear your feedback as I continue to work on the development of the game.

For those of you who have already tried the previous version of the demo, I thank you for your support and patience! I promise you that this update is worth the wait. And for those of you who haven't had the chance to try Toziuha Night yet, now is the perfect time to dive into this exciting world full of alchemy and action!

Stay tuned to social media and the official Toziuha Night website for more details on the development of this project, and remember to share your opinions and experiences as you play! Your feedback is invaluable to me and will help me make Toziuha Night: Order of the Alchemists an even better game.

Thank you all for your continued support!

...

I've worked a lot on this demo (and I'm still quite busy developing the game), I'm quite tired... so much that the text you've read so far is made with ChatGPT and I only modified a couple of things.

But these words come from me, I hope the demo will be well received and there will be many downloads, meanwhile today Monday 19th, I will take a break, putting in order many things in my house and watch some anime that I haven't had the chance to finish.

[b]Danny Garay
Developer of Toziuha Night: Order of the Alchemists[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42870047/666a682be2cbd8a2f925e8dd15713bf20fd565fe.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Fan translations for Toziuha Night OotA open on Github
notes.content:
[h1]I have released the translation files for Toziuha Night: OotA on github.[/h1]

[b]As many of you know, my native language is Spanish. [/b]I do my best writing the translation in English, many times I rely on deepL to translate, not having native experience with English, [i]so inevitably many mistakes are made.[/i]

I don't have a budget for translations either, everything has been through voluntary help, as it has happened with French and Portuguese. So on github will be available all the translatable text files in .csv format.

Anyone is welcome to take a look at them to find any bugs with my English, or even add new languages. Your translations will be properly credited, I will use your nickname on github to add it to the in-game credits screen.

[b]I for my part officially only guarantee English and Spanish for my game.[/b] In the repository I have put a link to a program I developed that may help to facilitate the translation task.

[url=https://github.com/dannygaray60/toziuha-night-oota-revamped-translation]https://github.com/dannygaray60/toziuha-night-oota-revamped-translation[/url]
